summary.root_cause_text: Deploy v1.6 (payments client HTTP library upgrade) fails to serialize Decimal amounts, so every provider call failed silently and orders were marked processed without payment.
recommended: Fix Decimal serialization in the v1.6 payments client and add a test before redeploying
Alert on payment provider call failures, which are currently logged only at DEBUG

events.text:
version: v1.6
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v1
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
The v1.6 deploy broke payments. I'll roll it back.
Rolled back version v1.6 -> v1.3. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

root_causes: Deploy v1.6 (payments client HTTP library upgrade) fails to serialize Decimal amounts, so every provider call failed silently and orders were marked processed without payment.
evidence: payment DEBUG: provider call failed: Object of type Decimal is not JSON serializable (22x, order ids 15-36)
recent_changes: v1.6 payments client: upgrade HTTP library, 0 min ago
payment_gap: 13 of 27 orders processed with no payment
args.impact: Alert showed 13 orders processed without payment (unpaid total_sar 5593.59). reprocess_orders paid 35 orders, with money_recovered total_sar 18999.83 (SAR 6265.62, USD 3395.79). The 35 is larger than the 13 in the alert because orders kept arriving during the incident.
recommended_actions: Fix Decimal serialization in the v1.6 payments client and add a test before redeploying
Alert on payment provider call failures, which are currently logged only at DEBUG
args.summary: Deploy v1.6 broke payment calls with a Decimal JSON serialization error, and orders were marked processed without payment. I rolled back to v1.3 and reprocessed all unpaid orders. All invariants are green again.
